title: pyrethrum waldsteinii
intro: Pyrethrum waldsteinii, commonly known as Chrysanthemum waldsteinii or Korean chamomile, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Pyrethrum waldsteinii include calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and insomnia, and alleviating menstrual cramps and other women's health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
